turns.t: Doctor, he fell off his bike outside the house, and cut his lip, and one of his front teeth is loose.
Thank you. Is that right, Dev? You came off your bike? ~
Yeah. I hit the kerb. ~
When did it happen?
About an hour ago. I brought him straight here.
Did you hit your head, Dev, or black out at all?
No. I put my hands out and my mouth hit the ground.
He was awake the whole time, he was crying straight away.
Good. Any neck pain, or pain anywhere else?
My wrist hurts a bit. The left one.
Any vomiting or dizziness since?
No, nothing like that. I feel okay, just my mouth hurts.
Has he taken anything for the pain?
I gave him a spoonful of that pink medicine for children, I don't know the name.
Do you know how much?
Just a teaspoon, I think.
Thank you. Does he have any medical conditions?
Asthma, mild. Nothing else.
Let me check his pulse, oxygen and temperature. ~
Okay.
Pulse 96, oxygen 99 percent, temperature 36.8.
Is it all right? ~
All normal. Dev, can you open your mouth wide for me? ~
Ahh.
There's a cut on the inside of the upper lip, about a centimetre long, and it's stopped bleeding.
What about the tooth? ~
The upper left front tooth is loose, and slightly pushed back. It looks like a baby tooth, so we need to be careful.
Will it fall out? ~
Possibly. I'd like you to see a dentist today, and if they think it is needed, they may do an X-ray of the tooth.
I'll take him straight there. ~
The cut doesn't need stitches. Rinse with salt water, and give soft foods for a few days.
Okay. ~
And his wrist is tender but he can move it. If the pain gets worse, or it swells, we should X-ray it.
We'll watch it. ~
If he vomits, becomes sleepy, or the bleeding starts again, come back to us immediately.
Thank you, doctor. ~
